PM and MO. Philip Morris and Altria.

His holdings in Philip Morris grew to as much as $1.64 million through multiple purchases in 2025. Altria also appears in the portfolio.

One stretch in March alone included eight separate buys worth up to $275,000.

Philip Morris and Altria both stand to benefit from any loosening of rules around vapes, pouches, and traditional products.

A clear regulatory tailwind in a sector that faced years of tightening oversight before this shift.
